news.analysis: Maye struggled mightily in the first half, but turned things around in the second half on his way to three touchdowns, two through the air, one on the ground. It wasn't all pretty, but he made it work for fantasy managers, who are riding high on his hot streak.

news.contents: Tampa Bay Buccaneers running back Kenny Gainwell rushed for 140 yards on 25 carries during Sunday's Week 8 win over the Atlanta Falcons. It was a historic day for the Buccaneers, who won 16-0 despite completing zero pass attempts. This is the first time an NFL team has won a game without completing a pass since 1974. Instead, Tampa Bay ran the ball a whopping 56 times for 324 yards. Both Gainwell and Bucky Irving had 25+ carries and 140+ rushing yards in the victory, representing an enormous ...
news.title: Kenny Gainwell Handles an Enormous Workload in Bucs' Historic Win
